name: "Creatures target player controls attack … if able" reaches the picked player's creatures — Instigator, Taunt, Gideon Jura
notes: A group of a picked player with a requirement (2026-11-19): Instigator's "Creatures target player controls attack this turn if able" reaches only the picked player's creatures, and nobody before a player is picked. "During target opponent's next turn, creatures that player controls attack Gideon Jura if able": "that player" is the picked opponent, and "this card" names Gideon. Taunt ("… attack you if able") picked for yourself gives your creatures nothing: a creature cannot attack its own controller (_resolveTraitText).
